They cast no shadows on the grass, do not occlude the background correctly, and lack depth integration. Additionally, the clocks show unnaturally perfect uniformity in time and hand position, suggesting template reuse. While the pig itself is rendered with reasonable anatomical fidelity (despite some low-confidence pose keypoints in the expert audit), the severe lack of physical grounding for the majority of the prompt's objects (the clocks) drastically reduces the image's realism.
